title: Partners in Purpose: Exploring the Human–Working Dog Connection
content: This article explores the human–working dog relationship, starting with the contrast between pet-owner bonds and the more complex relationships that develop with working dogs. The text focuses on the crucial role of search and rescue teams (SAR) where working dogs are trained in detection, tracking, assistance, and protection. The study seeks to understand how SAR handlers perceive their bond with their canine partners and how these relationships impact teamwork and performance. An online survey of 183 SAR handlers reveals high levels of trust, emotional connection, and mutual reliance among SAR handlers and their dogs. These findings provide valuable insights for enhancing training practices, welfare standards, and working outcomes in working dog teams.
